parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance.
> You can query the instance ID by invoking [Query the list of data migration instances and details of each instance](~~208139~~), [Query the list of change tracking instances and details of each instance](~~49442~~), or [Query the list of data synchronization instances and details of each instance](~~49454~~).

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward. This is the default value.
- **Reverse**: reverse.
> You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to start the reverse synchronization link only when the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is a zero-ETL node. Valid values:

- **false**: no.
- **true**: yes.
